text: 周三（11月4日），土耳其伊斯坦布尔证交所全国100指数收涨4.12%，连续三个交易日反弹，报11478.13点，持续脱离2025年11月14日（收报10565.74点）以来最低收盘位10759.56点；在美国中期选举结果揭晓之际，早盘时段持续扩大涨幅，北京时间17:30以来持续交投于11500点附近。 在彭博跟踪的全球92个股票指数中，土耳其股票在11月4日（迄今）表现最佳。截至伊斯坦布尔时间下午5:22，BIST 30指数飙升4.6%，创5月22日以来的最大（盘中）涨幅。更广泛的伊斯坦布尔 100 指数上涨4.6%。 伊斯坦布尔证交所银行指数收涨5.
text_en: On Wednesday (November 4), Turkey's Istanbul Stock Exchange National 100 Index closed up 4.12% at 11,478.13 points, rebounding for a third consecutive trading day and continuing to move away from its lowest close of 10,759.56 points since November 14, 2025 (when it closed at 10,565.74 points); as US midterm election results emerged, it kept extending gains in the morning session and has traded around 11,500 points since 17:30 Beijing time. Among the 92 global stock indices tracked by Bloomberg, Turkish equities posted the best performance on November 4 (so far). As of 5:22 p.m. Istanbul time, the BIST 30 Index surged 4.6%, the largest intraday gain since May 22. The broader Istanbul 100 Index rose 4.6%. The Istanbul Stock Exchange Banks Index closed up 5.
